card.name: Start of the word spasticity
card.fires_on: The first piece of the word spasticity (Sp or sp) in muscle-tone and baclofen or botulinum toxin text. It also fires on a capital Sp starting a name such as Spina or Spiegel.

modes.label: Spasticity start
modes.description: The opening piece of spasticity, just before 'asticity'.

modes.label: Other Sp- words
modes.description: A capital Sp starting a name or term like Spina or Spiegel.

modes.label: Linking words near limb terms
modes.description: Small words like of or for in lower-limb or fracture wording.

card.writes: It adds the rest of the word spasticity, such as 'asticity', and weakly suppresses unrelated tokens.
card.plain: It fires when the word spasticity is just starting, so the model can complete it.
